propositions: An unchanged related ticket pinned with a supported historical fingerprint generation is falsely classified as stale-pin-drift because derive_health compares only against the latest fingerprint

The attestation layer's derive_plan_material_pin_health wrapper supplies only current_material_fingerprint but does not apply the _legacy_material_ok compatibility check that already exists for own-ticket attestations
A valid pin matching a supported historical full-fingerprint recomputation of current material should be classified current, not stale, to align with the related-material drift invalidation boundary

The fix requires adding a narrowly scoped compatibility predicate to derive_health that accepts pins matching either the latest or any supported historical fingerprint generation of the current related ticket
